description: This Java class handles the rejection of client transfer commands within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and interacts with the TransferWritePlatformService to process the rejection.

classes.name: RejectClientTransferCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands for rejecting client transfer requests. It is marked with Spring's @Service annotation and is linked to a command type for rejecting transfer actions.

methods.name: RejectClientTransferCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the TransferWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the reject transfer command by invoking the write platform service's rejectClientTransfer method.
